about.title: About
about.description: ED Resilience Consulting, an institutional consulting and advisory firm: mission, vision, values and founder.
about.heading: A firm committed to more resilient institutions
about.intro: ED Resilience Consulting helps organisations build their capacity to face risk, crises and the challenges of recovery.
about.mission.title: Building capacity to protect the future
about.mission.text: We help public institutions, civil society organisations and businesses understand their risks, prepare and recover. Our conviction: a well-prepared organisation better protects the people it serves.
about.vision.title: Our vision
about.vision.text: Institutions able to anticipate crises, sustain their essential missions and build a safer future for their communities.
about.illustrationAlt: Illustration: a globe circled by a gold ring above a rising sun
about.values.title: What guides our work
about.values.intro: Four principles shape every assignment, from the first conversation to the handover of tools.
value.rigor.title: Rigour
value.rigor.text: Analysis based on proven methods and verifiable data.
value.commitment.title: Commitment
value.commitment.text: Real involvement alongside your teams, all the way to results.
value.proximity.title: Proximity
value.proximity.text: In-depth knowledge of the local context and close attention to your needs.
value.impact.title: Impact
value.impact.text: Useful, lasting solutions, measured against your objectives.
about.founder.name: Ernestia Dessejour
about.founder.bio: Ernestia Dessejour founded ED Resilience Consulting to put her experience at the service of organisations facing risk and crises. She supports institutions in building their capacity, from risk analysis to leading recovery.
